terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.

terms.name: Trajectory persistence
terms.definition: A tendency for an agent to continue an established approach despite information suggesting the approach is inappropriate, unsafe, or outside scope. In controlled incident replays, continued behavior was observed. The explanation that prior actions and compaction summaries create a self-reinforcing “momentum” remains a researcher hypothesis, not a verified causal mechanism [8–10].
